strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox latolla: e hlahloba lebokoso la dikonopo la hajwale kgahlanong le lenane la hlakollo la Google (CRL) mme e leke mehlodi e mengata ho fihlela e fumana lebokoso la dikonopo le sebetsang, le bekapo ya othomathike le ho qala botjha ha ditshebeletso tsa Google. E matha ka pompong e 'ngoe le e' ngoe 'me e hloka marang-rang (metsotso e 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Lebokose la linotlolo ho tsoa marang-rang: khoasolla lebokose la likonopo ho tsoa polokelong ea semmuso (GitHub) ebe e le boloka ho /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. E hloka inthanete mme e nka metsotso e 1-3. E sebelisoa ha ho lata ka bohlale ho hloleha kapa ha lebokose la likonopo le fetoloa ka letsoho.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP tlhahlobo: lekola limojule tse fumanehang tsa Remote Key Provisioning, lekola mofuta oa setifikeiti sa bopaki sa TEE, le ho bontša boemo ba sesebelisoa sa KmInstallKeybox. Ha e fetole letho - pono e hlakileng ea boemo ba sesebelisoa.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine hlahloba (bala-feela): e bonts'a Widevine matšoao a boemo (L1/L3) ho tsoa ho dumpsys, DRM (IDM) boteng ba faele ea linotlolo, le thepa e amanang le sistimi. Ha e fetole letho ho hang.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP lokisa: e tsamaisa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh bukana. E lokisa litaba tsa bopaki ha pase ea othomathiki e hloleha. Lebelo le leng le le leng le hatisa mola o hlakileng oa katleho / ho hloleha.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Feletseng RKP lokisa: matha sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh tletseng. E sebetsana le linyeoe tse thata mme e nka nako e telele. Sephetho se hlakileng se hlaha qetellong.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Seta botjha GMS: hlakola Play Store le Google ditshebeletso (GMS+GSF) ya data ebe o reboots sesebediswa ka bohona. Bakeng sa bopaki bo manganga feela - ha ho mohla e amang linepe kapa lifaele tsa hau.
strings.mdCertify: • Setifikeiti sa ho bapala: lekola boemo ba bopaki ba setifikeiti sa RKP sa sesebelisoa le ho hlophisa bocha thepa ea bopaki ha ho hlokahala. Ha e ame data ea mosebelisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER lokisa: lokisa Google moralo oa litšebeletso (SOTER) litaba tse amanang le bopaki ba sesebelisoa. E sebedisetsoa lisebelisoa tse ling tse itšetlehileng ka SOTER sebakeng sa Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF hlahloba: e bonts'a boemo ba enjene e kentsoeng, lifaele tsa menoana (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), le li-log. Sheba feela - ha e fetole letho.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Li-slots tsa li-keybox ( tsa mantlha / tsa bobeli)
strings.hintKbSlots: Mojule o laola libaka tse peli tsa li-keybox: ea mantlha (e halalela, ha e so hlakoloe) le ea bobeli (bekapo). Taba ena e bonts'a hore na ke slot efe e sebetsang, e fetola khetho, kapa e phahamisa ea bobeli ho ea ho ea mantlha ka kopo e hlakileng - ka li-backups le log e felletseng.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Tlhahlobo ea botšepehi: e hlahloba TEE senotlolo sa ho kenya, ente ea laebrari ka har'a keystore2, boemo ba ho hlakoloa (CRL), tšireletso ea lenane la tšireletso le boemo ba RKP. Bala feela - ha e fetole letho.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Kenya kopo hape e bolokehileng:

• Lethathamo la tshireletso le hahilwe bocha ho tsoa ho sesebelisoa se seng le se seng se kentsoeng.
• The custom-ROM comppatibility layer is re-apped.
• Lebokose la likonopo le sebetsang le sebelisoa hape.
• Google Play#000000start6#litšebeletso li qala hape keybox ha ho mohla e angoang.

Tswelela?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Likonopo tsa likonopo: e bonts'a boemo ba li-slots tsa mantlha le tsa bobeli le ho chencha khetho lipakeng tsa tsona. Ea mantlha (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) e lula e sirelelitsoe ebile ha e hlakoloe. Ho nyolla ea bobeli ho ea ho ea mantlha ho hloka netefatso e hlakileng.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Ntshetsapele sekotjana sa bobedi ho ya ho primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml eba dikahare tsa sekotjana sa mantlha.
• The primary primary e bolokwa e le bekapo pele e ka nkelwa sebaka.
• Ha ho letho le hlakolwang — tshebetso e ka kgutlisetswa morao.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Hlakola sekotjana sa bobeli:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml se tla tlosoa.
• The primary slot ha e amehe.

Tswelela?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (e ntjha ho v3.17):

• E lekola lebokoso la dikonopo la hajwale kgahlanong le lenane la Google hlakolwa (CRL).
• Leka mehloli e mengata ho fihlela lebokoso la dikonopo le hlwekileng le fumanwa.
• Automatic backup + restarts#00000#5 # #           # ditshebeletso inthanete (1-3 mets). Na u batla ho tsoela pele?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Lata keybox ho tsoa Marang-rang:

• Khoasolla konopo ea semmuso ebe oa e netefatsa.
• E kentsoe ruri (ha e e-so ka e khutlisoa butle).

⚠️ E Hloka inthanete (ho isa ho 1 mets). Na u batla ho tsoela pele?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Tokisetso botjha RKP linotlolo:

• Ha ho na data kapa difaele tsa keybox tse hlakolwang.
• Qala fono botjha kamora moo.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Tokiso e felletseng:

• Lipehelo bocha RKP + qala hape Google lits'ebeletso.
• Sesebediswa se ithomela hape (ha ho letho le hlakolwang).

Tswelela?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Qala botjha Google ditshebeletso:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — qala hape feela.
• Ha ho letho le hlakotsweng mme HA O TLA HO ntshiwa.
• Sesebediswa se itshimoloha hape.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Qobella ho fana hape (Red Magic):

• Bakeng sa lisebelisoa tse iphapanyetsang keybox e dutletseng.
• E sebetsa le haeba linotlolo li phetse hantle.
• Ha ho na data e hlakotsoeng.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmCertify:
Qobella Play Store certification:

• Hlakola cache ea Store feela — ak'haonte ea hau ha e sebetse.
• Qala bocha, ebe u bula Store.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER lokisa:

• E qala hape tshebeletso ya vendor.soter.
• E hlakola SOTER data ya seva feela.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Sebelisa menoana (PIF):

• E fetolela custom.pif.prop ebe e e kenya tseleng ea enjene.
• E hloka ho qalisa bocha ka mor'a moo.

Tswelela?
strings.confirmCanary:
Nchafatso ea menoana ea Canary:

• Khoasolla mongolo oa morao-rao oa molao oa Canary ho tsoa ho Google.
• E Syncs the security patch + restarts Google services (no hlakola).

⚠️ E Hloka inthanete (1-3 min). Na u batla ho tsoela pele?
